itens.trecho: Único dentro do género ‘western’, entendemos melhor este filme à luz da época em que foi feito. Butch Cassidy, Sundance Kid e o gangue de Hole in the Wall fazem parte da “Galeria da Fama” dos grandes bandoleiros e salteadores do Velho Oeste.

At a time when humor was not common in Western films, this one won me over, even its soundtrack is delightfully funny, with a modern and contemporary aura... And the eternal magic of transforming criminals, murderers and thieves into national heroes, with great sympathy and 'honesty'.

This is what you might call "lightly likable". It's a comic Western about the two famous outlaws of the Hole in the Wall gang. I saw it at the Louisville cinema when it came out, and I wasn't thrilled, but I wasn't totally averse to it.
